title: Scalable Cellular Image Analysis: Adapting Cellpose for High-Throughput Server-Based Processing
content: In microscopic imaging numerous biological applications necessitate the segmentation of cellular structures. Segmenting areas of interest within a single image for analysis presents significant challenges. Background noise and image quality can lead to false positives or false negatives object segmentation [1]. This challenge is amplified when analysis is performed at a centralized imaging center with a diverse range of images from various sources (e.g., cell culture, tissue, or whole organism). Each type of image requires different strategies for the segmentation and can be comprised of hundreds of separate image sets. Analyzing this volume of acquired images can quickly escalate into big data, making accurate and robust object segmentation even more complex [2].
